title: Where Is My Puzzle Piece?
can_do: 找不到熟悉物品时主动询问位置，并请求一起寻找。
trigger: The final red puzzle piece is not beside the puzzle where the child expects it.
stretch_response: Where's my red puzzle piece? Can you help me look?
repair_response: Not that piece. Mine is red.
essential_props: a puzzle with one loose piece

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Your puzzle is waiting. Do you have the last piece?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: No. Where's my red puzzle piece?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I saw a red piece near the sofa.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can you help me look under the sofa?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Here it is, beside the front leg.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I found it. Now I can finish my puzzle.

replay_cards.title: Find the hairbrush
replay_cards.change: The brush is not on the dresser
replay_cards.challenge: Ask where it is, follow Mom's clue, find it by the mirror, and finish brushing

replay_cards.title: Find the blue car
replay_cards.challenge: Ask Dad for help, check near the toy box, find the car, and resume the game

parent_support: Let the missing object matter to an activity already in progress.
Give one truthful location clue rather than turning the search into repeated guessing.
